findings.text: blocking: the render test injects its own coupling and a synthetic operator, so it never runs benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:_panel_display_coupling and never loads any of the five committed panel-states.npz archives, which is what the plan's done_when (1) asks for, so the code that actually draws every figure has no test.

non-blocking: a state file without a current key silently keeps the lattice raster, so an archive that lost its currents draws a plausible solve-resolution figure instead of failing, and the absent archive test is what would have caught it.

non-blocking: the docstring still says eight open states trace a cycle and one admits none, while the re-measured PERSISTED_STATE_TERMS pins four cycle-tracing states (0, 2, 7, 8) plus state 1, and line 874 still says state 19 carries its own wider control displacement when state 19 now uses the default 1e-3.
non-blocking: DEFAULT_DISPLAY_SPACING restates nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:44 DEFAULT_SPACING, so the 10 mm floor can drift between the two copies.

non-blocking: the tests line states a result rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so promotion can only recover the gate from the log header, and neither gate log names the revision it ran at.

item_verdicts.diff: read all twenty commits from 3ef818dfa to 1f1391bd0; the code change is confined to benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py (_panel_display_coupling, _panel_display_map, _panel_moments, the display branch of _paint_panel, the wrapped caption, the panel receipts and the new archive keys), tests/test_coil_edit_panel_render.py, the re-measured PERSISTED_STATE_TERMS, the five figures with their receipts and archives, and the evidence fragment, with nova/ untouched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks a render test to redraw each of the five figures' panels from its own state file and to carry a failing 1 percent conductor-current control; tests/test_coil_edit_panel_render.py:176 instead draws one synthetic 7x7 lattice with a coupling it supplies itself and states no control, so clause (1) is not asserted, while clause (2) is met by the five committed archives and their receipts.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is the five coil-edit converged-vs-nonconverged figures re-solved and drawn from fine flux maps, and all five were redrawn at 10 mm through nova/equilibrium/display_flux.build_display_flux_map, with docs/figures/single-grid-solver-cutover/panel-receipt.json and docs/figures/forward-solve-api/coil-edit-nonconvergence/panel-receipt.json recording spacing_m 0.01 and reproduction errors 6.78e-12 and 7.20e-12.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the delivered attempt-5 manifest, since the live file now reads status in-progress under a resume; it records the 43-passed gate, the archive md5s d40d470f and 3a446573, the per-figure receipts and the re-measured pins, but its tests line at manifest.md:13 is a prose summary rather than the literal command and neither gate log names the revision it ran at.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence names three mast-centroid files individually plus four figure directories, the benchmark and both test files; every landed path is inside them except docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/panel-states.npz and docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/panel-receipt.json, which the manifest reports under outside_scope.

justifications.durability: no test fails if benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:_panel_display_coupling regresses, because tests/test_coil_edit_panel_render.py:207 hands the builder its own coupling, and the 1 percent control that would catch it is an uncommitted scratch script under /tmp rather than a test.
justifications.evidence: the gate recorded at tests/test_coil_edit_panel_render.py:209 asserts only a synthetic map against a synthetic operator, so it measures neither the done_when's five-archive redraw nor its 1 percent control, although the shipped receipts do record the real 6.78e-12 and 7.20e-12 reproduction errors and the recorded gate is green at 43 passed.
justifications.fit: the added helpers follow the module's own naming and style, but tests/test_flux_surface_connectivity.py:880 documents a mechanism the re-measured table no longer pins.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all five figures under docs/figures/forward-solve-api/coil-edit-nonconvergence, docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability, docs/figures/single-grid-solver-cutover and docs/figures/cpu-compile-abort/coil-edit-regeneration-row are redrawn at 10 mm from the display map and their non-converged captions carry the largest node mismatch.
justifications.reuse: benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:99 introduces DEFAULT_DISPLAY_SPACING for a floor nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:44 already owns as DEFAULT_SPACING, while the coupling and moment route correctly reuse parity._plasma_response, parity._stored_circuit_fields and the operator's cell_current.
justifications.scope_discipline: two files under docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/ (panel-states.npz and panel-receipt.json) fall outside the file-by-file fence and are disclosed under outside_scope rather than hidden.
